title: Findings adjudication
description: The adjudicator's raw output (docs/specs/adjudicator.md section 6). Written verbatim to adjudication.json; findings.json carries the APPLIED result. Every bound here is re-enforced in adjudicate.apply() -- the schema is the first gate, never the only one.

verdicts.description: One entry per adjudicated finding, joined on finding_id -- NEVER by position. A finding you do not mention is kept at its provisional severity (the silence rule).

finding_id.description: The join key, copied exactly from the docket row.

severity.description: Final 1-9; null only when discarded. apply() clamps: quarantined rows to 3; an upgrade to at most provisional+2 unless the category is merged_pattern; an upgrade with an ineligible category reverts to the provisional. No ceiling: any rung 1-9 may be written.

rationale.description: One or two sentences a named author could read.

evidence_quote.description: REQUIRED for innocent_explanation clears and discards: a verbatim span from the paper that supports the clearing. Verified against the text -- an unlocatable quote DEMOTES the clear to kept.

merged_into.description: Required iff action == merged: the surviving finding_id. No chains -- the target must itself be kept/downgraded/upgraded.

title.description: Optional rewrite, at most 90 characters; a longer one is accepted up to 160 but stored cut to 90 at a word boundary (the full text kept in the row's notes). The original is preserved as adjudication.title_was.

description.description: Optional rewrite; the original is preserved as adjudication.description_was.

verdict.description: does_not_reconcile: a kept finding shows the printed record contradicts itself or cannot be true as printed, even if the cause may be innocent. unresolved: the checks could not settle it (probabilistic signals only, deciding values unreported, or an unstated premise). reconciles: every runnable check came out consistent.

paper_severity.description: The paper-level rung, 1-9; apply() only guards a malformed number. No ceiling (v1.14.0).

headline_finding_id.description: Must name a kept/upgraded/downgraded problem row -- never discarded or merged; apply() falls back to severity order otherwise.

summary.description: The bounded narrative that replaces report_markdown. Written in the register the published disclaimer can support.
